Exposome-wide scan of gene expression on the 57 pregnancy exposures, their
squares and pairwise (and, in the exploratory version, three-way)
products, adjusted for the gene-expression covariates.

Sources: `EnvBRAN/high_exposure.ipynb` (one transcript, includes three-way
terms) and `EnvBRAN/script_high_exposure.jl` (batch run over all
transcripts with squares + unique pairwise products; it wrote ~32k
`gexpr_results*/<gene>.txt` files, which are **not** in git – the batch
writes to `results/gexpr_results/`).

```{julia}
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Statistics, LinearAlgebra, Distributions, CSV, Parquet, Combinatorics
using Arrow
DATA = joinpath(pkgdir(ExposomicsJulia), ".data")
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
DT = DataFrame(Arrow.Table(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "clean_dt.arrow")));
genexpr     = CSV.read(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "genexpr_num.csv"), DataFrame);
genexpr_cov = DataFrame(read_parquet(joinpath(DATA, "helix", "genexpr_cov.parquet")));
genexpr_t = permutedims(genexpr, 1);
rename!(genexpr_t, :rn => :ID);

DT = innerjoin(genexpr_cov, DT, on = :ID);
DT = innerjoin(DT, genexpr_t, on = :ID);
DT = DT[completecases(DT), :];

exposure_label = names(DT, Between(:h_abs_ratio_preg_Log, :h_thm_preg_Log));
M_exp = rescale(Matrix{Float64}(DT[:, exposure_label]));
# adjustment covariates: columns 3, 5–12 of the joined table (from genexpr_cov),
# as in the original code
covars = Matrix{Float64}(DT[:, names(DT)[[3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12]]]);
```

## Design: main effects, squares and pairwise products

```{julia}
#| eval: false
pairs  = collect(combinations(1:length(exposure_label), 2))
E2     = reduce(hcat, [M_exp[:, i] .* M_exp[:, j] for (i, j) in pairs])
Esq    = M_exp .^ 2
EM     = hcat(M_exp, Esq, E2)
labels = vcat(exposure_label,
              exposure_label .* " × " .* exposure_label,
              [exposure_label[i] * " × " * exposure_label[j] for (i, j) in pairs]);
```

Optional three-way products (all ordered triples, 57³ ≈ 185k terms, as in
the exploratory notebook — memory hungry):

```{julia}
#| eval: false
triples = vec([(i, j, k) for i in 1:57, j in 1:57, k in 1:57])
E3 = reduce(hcat, [M_exp[:, i] .* M_exp[:, j] .* M_exp[:, k] for (i, j, k) in triples])
```

## One transcript

```{julia}
#| eval: false
ewas_results = exposure_scan(Float64.(DT[:, "TC01000001.hg.1"]), EM, covars; names = labels)
show(ewas_results[ewas_results.bonferroni, :])
```

## All transcripts (batch)

Writes the Bonferroni-significant terms of each transcript to
`results/gexpr_results/<gene>.txt`. Run as a script with
`julia --threads=auto --project=.`.

```{julia}
#| eval: false
outdir = joinpath(pkgdir(ExposomicsJulia), "results", "gexpr_results"); mkpath(outdir)
for (j, gene) in enumerate(string.(genexpr.rn))
    println("Analyze #", j, ": ", gene)
    res = exposure_scan(Float64.(DT[:, gene]), EM, covars; names = labels)
    sig = res[res.bonferroni, :]
    nrow(sig) > 0 && CSV.write(joinpath(outdir, gene * ".txt"), sig; delim = '\t')
end
```
